dhp221:1: One should put away anger; one should utterly renounce pride; one should overcome every attachment.
dhp221:3: He who clings not to Name and Form, and is free from attachment, is not beset with pain.
dhp222:1: Whoever controls his anger like a swift-speeding chariot, when it is aroused, –
dhp222:3: Him I call a charioteer; other folk are merely holders of reins.
dhp223:1: One should overcome anger with kindness;
dhp223:2: One should overcome evil with good;
dhp223:3: One should overcome the niggard with gifts,
dhp223:4: And the speaker of falsehood with truth.
dhp224:1: A man should speak the truth, a man should not get angry,
dhp224:2: A man should give, when asked to give a little;
dhp224:3: By these three acts a man may attain the World of the Gods.
dhp225:1: They who do no injury, the sages, they who ever control their bodies,
dhp225:3: Such go to a place from which they pass no more; and having gone there, sorrow not.
dhp226:1: They that are ever watchful, they that study both by day and by night,
dhp226:3: They that strive after Nibbāna, such men rid themselves of the evil passions.
dhp227:1: This is an old, old saying, Atula, this is no mere saying of to-day:
dhp227:3: “They blame him who sits silent, they blame him who says much,
dhp227:5: They also blame him who says little.” There is no one in the world that is not blamed.
dhp228:1: There never was, there never will be, there lives not now
dhp228:3: A man who receives unqualified blame or unqualified praise.
dhp229:1: If men of intelligence always, from day to day, praise
dhp229:3: Some man as free from flaws, wise, endowed with learning and goodness, –
dhp230:1: Who would venture to find fault with such a man, any more than with a coin made of gold of the Jambu river?
dhp230:3: Even the gods praise such a man, even by Brahmā is he praised.
dhp231:1: Angry deeds should one control; one should be restrained in action;
dhp231:3: One should renounce evil deeds; one should do good deeds.
dhp232:1: Angry words should one control; one should be restrained in word;
dhp232:3: One should renounce evil words; one should speak good words.
dhp233:1: Angry thoughts should one control; one should be restrained in thought;
dhp233:3: One should renounce evil thoughts; one should cultivate good thoughts.
dhp234:1: Wise men who control their deeds, wise men who control their speech,
dhp234:3: Wise men who control their thoughts, such men are indeed well controlled.
